title: 커밋 타임라인 — 검토 서비스
description: 업무 DB(Postgres, 읽기 전용 grafana_ro)로 커밋 하나가 배포까지 간 길을 본다

target.rawSql: SELECT received_at AS time, app || ' ' || kind || ' ' || left(image_tag, 7) AS text, app, target_env FROM deploy_events WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at)

options.content: 위 **sha**(PR head 또는 병합 SHA 앞부분)나 **pr**(PR 번호)를 넣으면 그 검토의 단계가 한 줄씩 나온다. 둘 다 비우면 최근 검토 10개. 시각 열은 0009 마이그레이션 뒤 검토부터 채워진다.

panels.title: 단계별 타임라인
panels.description: 생성 → 판정 → 사람 결정 → 병합 → gitops 커밋 → 배포 알림. intake 가 있었으면 맨 앞

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT * FROM reviews r
  WHERE
  (${sha:sqlstring} = '' OR r.pr_head_sha LIKE ${sha:sqlstring} || '%' OR r.merge_sha LIKE ${sha:sqlstring} || '%')
  AND (${pr:sqlstring} = '' OR r.pr_number::text = ${pr:sqlstring})
  ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10
), stages AS (
  SELECT review_id, '검토 생성' AS stage, created_at AS at FROM r
  UNION ALL SELECT review_id, '판정 ' || coalesce(verdict, ''), judged_at FROM r
  UNION ALL SELECT review_id, '사람 ' || coalesce(human_decision->>'decision', '') ||
                   coalesce(' (' || (human_decision->>'approver') || ')', ''), human_decided_at FROM r
  UNION ALL SELECT review_id, '병합 ' || left(merge_sha, 7), merged_at FROM r
  UNION ALL SELECT review_id, 'gitops 커밋 ' || left(gitops_commit_sha, 7), gitops_committed_at FROM r
  UNION ALL SELECT r.review_id, '끝 ' || r.status || coalesce(': ' || left(r.error, 60), ''), r.updated_at FROM r
            WHERE r.status IN ('failed', 'blocked', 'rejected', 'superseded')
  UNION ALL SELECT d.review_id, '배포 ' || d.kind || ' ' || left(coalesce(d.image_tag, ''), 7), d.received_at
            FROM deploy_events d JOIN r USING (review_id)
  UNION ALL SELECT i.review_id, 'intake ' || i.kind || ' → ' || i.status || coalesce(' ' || i.reason, ''), i.created_at
            FROM spec_intakes i JOIN r USING (review_id)
)
SELECT r.spec_ref->>'repository' AS "레포", r.pr_number AS "PR", left(r.pr_head_sha, 7) AS "head",
       s.review_id AS "검토", s.stage AS "단계", s.at AS "시각",
       extract(epoch FROM s.at - lag(s.at) OVER (PARTITION BY s.review_id ORDER BY s.at)) AS "앞 단계부터",
       extract(epoch FROM s.at - min(s.at) OVER (PARTITION BY s.review_id)) AS "시작부터"
FROM stages s JOIN r USING (review_id)
WHERE s.at IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, s.at

SELECT
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM judged_at - created_at)) AS "판정까지",
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM human_decided_at - judged_at)) AS "사람 결정까지",
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM merged_at - coalesce(human_decided_at, judged_at)))
    AS "병합까지 (CI 포함)",
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM gitops_committed_at - merged_at)) AS "gitops 커밋까지"
FROM reviews r
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.created_at)

panels.title: 최근 50건
panels.description: 진행 중이면 지금까지, 끝났으면 끝난 시각까지. 막힌 단계가 비어 있으면 배포까지 끝난 것

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.created_at AS "생성", r.spec_ref->>'repository' AS "레포", r.pr_number AS "PR",
       left(r.pr_head_sha, 7) AS "head", r.status AS "상태", r.verdict AS "판정",
       extract(epoch FROM CASE
         WHEN r.status IN ('received', 'reviewing', 'needs_human', 'waiting_ci', 'merging') THEN now()
         WHEN r.status = 'committed' THEN coalesce(d.healthy_at, d.degraded_at, r.gitops_committed_at, r.updated_at)
         ELSE r.updated_at
       END - r.created_at) AS "총 소요",
       CASE
         WHEN r.status IN ('received', 'reviewing') THEN '검토 중'
         WHEN r.status = 'needs_human' THEN '사람 확인 대기'
         WHEN r.status = 'waiting_ci' THEN 'CI 대기'
         WHEN r.status = 'merging' THEN '병합·gitops 커밋'
         WHEN r.status = 'committed' AND d.healthy_at IS NOT NULL THEN ''
         WHEN r.status = 'committed' AND d.degraded_at IS NOT NULL THEN '배포 Degraded'
         WHEN r.status = 'committed' THEN '배포 확인 대기'
         WHEN r.status = 'superseded' THEN '새 커밋·닫힘에 밀림'
         ELSE r.status || coalesce(': ' || left(r.error, 80), '')
       END AS "막힌 단계"
FROM reviews r
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT min(received_at) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'healthy') AS healthy_at,
         min(received_at) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'degraded') AS degraded_at
  FROM deploy_events WHERE review_id = r.review_id
) d ON true
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.created_at)
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
LIMIT 50
